Empowering employees.

We believe in the power of cross-functional collaboration to reach bold goals. Our leadership team and employees talk freely with each other, to keep the workplace fair for everyone.

Plasto-Fab is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age or disability.
